PDF_Summary: Quick Start Guide: 1. Sign up: - There are three ways to sign up: sign up with email, sign up with Google account, and sign up through invitation. - To sign up with email, access www.clo-set.com and click the sign up button. Complete the sign up form and a verification email will be sent to your email address. Click the ACTIVATE button in the verification email to complete the sign up process. - To sign up with a Google account, access www.clo-set.com and click the LOGIN WITH GOOGLE button. Agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and click the ACCEPT button. - To sign up through invitation, click the ACCEPT button in the invitation email and sign up with the invited email address. Only enter the password to complete the sign up process. 2. Sign in: - You can sign in with your email address and password if you signed up with the email sign up method. Make sure to confirm the email verification before signing in. - You can sign in with your Google account if you signed up with the Google account sign up method. 3. Browse: - After signing in, you will see the landing page where you can see the companies you have access to. Click on one of the company icons to enter a company. - Within a company, you can navigate through different brands, seasons, and workrooms using the navigation bar. 4. Upload: - To upload a single file, click the UPLOAD FILES button and select the file you want to upload. Fill out the information and click the UPLOAD button. - To create turntable images, select Render > Render in the main menu. Select Turntable Images in Medium and enter the Image Count. Click the Render button and specify the folder and file name to save the images. - To upload turntable images, click the UPLOAD FILES button and select the images you want to upload. Fill out the information and click the UPLOAD button. 5. View: - To view the information on a style, click on the style thumbnail in the workroom. You can see the style creator, version information, common information, and more. - To view 3D garments and turntable images, click the Play button to load the data. You can rotate, zoom, and pan the garment using the same interface as in CLO. You can also view the style in full screen. 6. Version control: - To upload a new version of a style, click the NEW VERSION button. Select the type of version and follow the same process as uploading a single file. 7. Style share: - To share a style via a URL link, click the SHARE button and select the LINK tab. Change the status and copy the link to share with others. Only users with the link can view or edit the style. - To share a style with other users via email, click the SHARE button and select the PEOPLE tab. Set the access permission, enter the email addresses, and click SEND. 8. Comment: - Communicate with collaborators by using the comment feature. Enter comments and mention other users to invite them to the style. You can search for all CLOSET members using the mention feature. 9. My files: - In the My files section, you can see the styles that you created, the styles marked as favorites, and the styles shared by other collaborators. Admin Guide: 1. Create room: - You can create companies, brands, seasons, and workrooms in the admin section. Click the create button and enter the necessary information to create a room. 2. Invite members: - To invite brand collaborators, click the invite button and enter the email addresses of the members. Click the send button to invite them. 3. Assign admin: - Select the Collaborator menu to assign brand and company admins. Click the Admin Setting button and select the admin role. 4. Delete room: - You can delete companies, brands, and seasons in the admin section. Only company admins can edit and delete companies. Click the Admin Setting button and select the delete option for the room you want to delete. Please note that some features may not be available yet, and if you encounter any bugs, please report them to hello@clo-set.com.
